title: WaterLens Supported-Capability Matrix
description: Which data capabilities WaterLens supports, their candidate source families, and whether they need local measurement or can be inferred from imagery. PROPOSED pending domain review. 'supported: false' capabilities render as 'unavailable', never 0.

supportLevel.supported: A deterministic method + validated source can produce this now.
supportLevel.provisional: Partially derivable; needs caveats and/or a reviewed model.
supportLevel.unavailable: Not derivable from current evidence; needs local data / reviewed model.

capabilities.notes: Gridded precipitation is available from EE, but converting rainfall to usable supply (runoff/harvesting) needs a reviewed response model (see metrics.md). Rainfall depth itself is observable; supply impact is not a flat percentage.
Groundwater levels/trends require in-situ well measurements. Satellite proxies (e.g. GRACE) are coarse and not a substitute at community scale. Unavailable until local data onboarded.
Surface-water extent/occurrence is observable from imagery; converting extent to usable volume/yield needs bathymetry/assumptions and review.
Drinking-water quality (chemical/biological) cannot be inferred from imagery. Requires sampled measurements. Unavailable until local data onboarded.
Terrain/DEM and past flood extents help, but calibrated flood risk needs hydrological/drainage modelling and review. Not inferable from a single imagery layer.
Land cover / built-up fraction is a standard imagery-derived product with documented classes; most directly supportable, subject to licence and class mapping.
Piped/tanker supply volumes and reliability come from utility/operator records, not imagery. Required for demand/supply/deficit metrics. Unavailable until onboarded.

Neighbour/shared-aquifer hydraulic effects need a coupled groundwater model + boundary evidence. Distance alone never becomes a validated impact score. Unavailable until adequate coupled evidence exists.
